name: ecr-public
description: Amazon Elastic Container Registry Public Amazon Elastic Container Registry Public (Amazon ECR Public) is a managed container image registry service.

subcommands.name: batch-check-layer-availability
subcommands.description: Checks the availability of one or more image layers that are within a repository in a public registry.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-image
subcommands.description: Deletes a list of specified images that are within a repository in a public registry.

subcommands.name: complete-layer-upload
subcommands.description: Informs Amazon ECR that the image layer upload is complete for a specified public registry, repository name, and upload ID.

subcommands.name: create-repository
subcommands.description: Creates a repository in a public registry.

subcommands.name: delete-repository
subcommands.description: Deletes a repository in a public registry.

subcommands.name: delete-repository-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the repository policy that's associated with the specified repository.

subcommands.name: describe-image-tags
subcommands.description: Returns the image tag details for a repository in a public registry.

subcommands.name: describe-images
subcommands.description: Returns metadata that's related to the images in a repository in a public registry.

subcommands.name: describe-registries
subcommands.description: Returns details for a public registry.

subcommands.name: describe-repositories
subcommands.description: Describes repositories that are in a public registry.

subcommands.name: get-authorization-token
subcommands.description: Retrieves an authorization token.

subcommands.name: get-registry-catalog-data
subcommands.description: Retrieves catalog metadata for a public registry.

subcommands.name: get-repository-catalog-data
subcommands.description: Retrieve catalog metadata for a repository in a public registry.

subcommands.name: get-repository-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the repository policy for the specified repository.

subcommands.name: initiate-layer-upload
subcommands.description: Notifies Amazon ECR that you intend to upload an image layer.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List the tags for an Amazon ECR Public resource.

subcommands.name: put-image
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the image manifest and tags that are associated with an image.

subcommands.name: put-registry-catalog-data
subcommands.description: Create or update the catalog data for a public registry.

subcommands.name: put-repository-catalog-data
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the catalog data for a repository in a public registry.

subcommands.name: set-repository-policy
subcommands.description: Applies a repository policy to the specified public repository to control access permissions.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates the specified tags to a resource with the specified resourceArn.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes specified tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: upload-layer-part
subcommands.description: Uploads an image layer part to Amazon ECR.
